title: Primitive Continuation Reduction Rules
purpose: Introduce the first concrete reduction rules for simplifying continuation expressions toward NF(C) while preserving process equivalence.

canonical_claims.statement: Reduction rules operate on continuation expressions, not RT_core.
Reduction removes representational redundancy while preserving process behavior.
Identity continuations reduce away under valid composition.
Composed continuations may reduce to a direct continuation when lawful constraints are preserved.

rules.name: Composed Continuation Reduction
rules.condition: Only when endpoint compatibility, admissibility, residue propagation, and governing constraints are preserved.

validation_requirements: Reduction must remain distinct from symbolic rewrite.

next_recommended_patch.title: Well-Formed Continuation Expressions
next_recommended_patch.purpose: Define the grammar and type/domain constraints for valid RT continuation expressions.
